name: Nanami Haruka
source:
Haruka is the heroine of all the Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ games.
At the start of the 1st game she is a 15 year old girl who enrolls into Saotome Academy, in order to fulfill her dream to compose a song for her idol, Hayato.

She is a timid girl with a caring personality, with the ability to move people's hearts.

She shares room with Tomochika from Class A and is in Class A.
